title: Canada Business Corporations Act ss.20, 114 and 117
source: Canada Business Corporations Act, R.S.C. 1985, c. C-44, current to 2026-09-21, English and French versions. Read on laws-lois.justice.gc.ca 2026-10-09.

rules.text: The corporation keeps the minutes of the directors' meetings and resolutions (procès-verbaux des réunions et résolutions du conseil d'administration).
The directors act only with a quorum, a majority of the number of directors unless the articles or by-laws say otherwise; the minutes say one was present.
A resolution in writing signed by every director entitled to vote is as valid as one passed at a meeting, and a copy is kept with the minutes.
